source.title: A Scribbled Letter
source.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, <name>. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local hunter trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
source.objective: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.
